frame: local ENU at the site; rows south to north, columns west to east; heights relative to the site (curvature of the Moon included)
source: LRO LOLA RDR laser shots (NASA GSFC, LOLA team), USGS Astrogeology analysis-ready COPC tiles on AWS Open Data: s3://astrogeo-ard/moon/lro/lola/
processing: Delaunay linear interpolation of the shots + Gaussian smoothing (1 cell)
